# Three Engine docs still end the naming ritual at an operator confirm

## Context

Operator ruling, 2026-10-01 ~15:35Z: *"there is no such thing as 'operator approval needed'. and i demand to remove spots that say so. of course each peer gets a recommendation and can approve the team choice."* The skill itself is corrected in neomjs/neo-agent-skills#134 (PR neomjs/neo-agent-skills#135). This ticket is the Engine companion.

## The Problem

Three Engine docs summarize the `peer-naming` ritual as ending at "operator-confirmed":
- `learn/benefits/Introduction.md:147`: "peer-sketched, bearer-assented, operator-confirmed"
- `learn/agentos/ProgressiveDisclosureSkills.md:158`: the five-step chain ending "→ operator-confirmed"
- `learn/guides/fundamentals/CodebaseOverview.md:461`: the same chain

Once the skill's fix lands, these lines contradict it, and they teach readers a gate that does not exist.

## The Fix

Drop the operator step from all three lines. The ritual ends at the bearer's assent, with the peer veto unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] No Engine doc describes an operator confirmation of a Social Name: `operator-confirmed` and `operator confirm` no longer appear in a naming context under `learn/`.
- [ ] The shipped release notes (`.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.0.0.md`) stay untouched, because they are a historical record of what was codified in June.

## Out of Scope

Brain identity data and docs (a Brain companion ticket), and historical records.
